$comment: Contract for the GenerateExport server-side command (AD-003, AD-039, AD-034 manual only). Custom API parameter Type codes: 0=Boolean, 10=String.

customApi.name: al_GenerateExport
customApi.description: Produces one Trail Light file: creates the batch under the id given and snapshots the Daily or Quarterly file rows for the check dates given. Needs Edit on export.generate; idempotent per intent; writes an Audit Event.

requestParameters.name: BatchId
requestParameters.description: Id of the al_exportbatch to create (or a Draft batch to populate).

requestParameters.name: IdempotencyKey
requestParameters.description: Stable key for the intent; a replay returns the same result.

requestParameters.name: FileKind
requestParameters.description: Daily or Quarterly: which Trail Light file to produce.

requestParameters.name: CheckedFrom
requestParameters.description: First check date to include, yyyy-mm-dd. Omit for no lower bound.

requestParameters.name: CheckedTo
requestParameters.description: Last check date to include, yyyy-mm-dd. Omit for no upper bound.

responseProperties.name: AuditEventId
responseProperties.description: Id of the Audit Event written.

responseProperties.name: Conflict
responseProperties.description: True when an optimistic-concurrency conflict was detected.
